parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request.

parameters.name: DocumentCode
parameters.description: The document number of the registrant. Maximum length: 50 characters.

parameters.name: DocumentImage
parameters.description: The document image of the registrant (Base64-encoded). The original file size must be between 50 KB and 3 MB.

parameters.name: DocumentType
parameters.description: The document type of the registrant. For more information, see the appendix on document types.

parameters.name: Email
parameters.description: The email address. Maximum length: 300 characters.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the registrant. Maximum length: 255 characters.

parameters.name: Phone
parameters.description: The phone number of the registrant. Maximum length: 128 characters. If the country is China, the area code of a non-mobile phone number must match the city.

parameters.name: RegistrantId
parameters.description: The ID of the registrant profile.
